financials_interim.notes: COMPANY (standalone) basis. Same period as GROUP row -- see GROUP row's notes for shared context (cash-flow-comparative caveat, borrowings convention, subsequent event). operating_profit=782,548 is the P&L's own subtotal (Revenue 55,520 - Admin 3,009 - Other operating expense 37 + Gain on Disposal of subsidiary 709,984 = 782,548 -- Company has no 'Direct expenses'/COGS line and no Selling & distribution line). This Rs.709,984k Gain on Disposal of subsidiary (the LRD divestment to Lee Hedges PLC discussed in the GROUP row's notes) is the OVERWHELMING driver of Company profit this quarter -- without it, Company operating result would be roughly 55,520-3,009-37=52,474, in line with the prior year's comparable Rs.59,379k. This gain is a Company-only, non-recurring, intra-Group item that is eliminated entirely on consolidation (does not appear in the GROUP row). profit_before_tax=768,442: 782,548 - Net Finance Expenses (14,106) = 768,442, ties exactly (Company has no separate fair-value line). tax_expense=17,537: filing shows 'Tax (expense) ... (17,537)' bracketed = a genuine expense (2025: nil shown), so PBT 768,442 - tax 17,537 = 750,905, close to reported PAT of 750,904 (Rs.1k rounding). eps_basic=3.55 (Company EPS is based on 100% of Company profit over the same ~211.4mn shares, unlike the Group EPS which is diluted by NCI). gross_profit stored as Revenue less nil COGS (55,520) since the Company statement has no 'Direct expenses' line at all (that cost sits entirely within subsidiaries at Group level) -- cost_of_sales left blank rather than assumed zero, since 'nil COGS' for a real-estate holding company's own rental/service revenue is a presentation choice, not necessarily a true absence of cost. total_assets=13,395,842 vs Group's 30,332,972 -- Company's largest asset is 'Investment in subsidiaries' (9,580,691), reflecting its holding-company structure. short_term_borrowings=392,569 = Current portion of Interest bearing borrowings (388,213) PLUS Bank overdraft (4,356); long_term_borrowings=0 (no non-current interest bearing borrowings line at Company level). Identity check: total_liabilities (4,853,588) + total_equity (8,542,252) = 13,395,840, vs total_assets 13,395,842 (Rs.2k rounding), ties closely.

Lanka Realty Investments PLC (ASCO), Real Estate holding group (commercial property, land banking, leisure). GROUP basis. Quarter ended 30 June 2026 vs quarter ended 30 June 2025 comparative, both explicitly presented on the face P&L (page 4/6 -- the filing repeats the same P&L on pages 6 and 7, headed 'For the Period Ended' and 'For the Quarter Ended' respectively; both are single-quarter figures since this is Q1 of the fiscal year, so income_statement_page cites page 6). operating_profit=79,658 is the P&L's own unlabelled subtotal (Gross profit 179,434 + Other operating income 39,691 - Administration expenses 134,575 - Selling & distribution 3,446 - Other operating expense 1,447 = 79,658), before Net Finance Expenses and the fair-value line. profit_before_tax=39,862: 79,658 - Net Finance Expenses (58,707) + Change in fair value of Investment property/Inventory (18,911) = 39,862, ties exactly. IMPORTANT: this fair-value line is a distinct, materially large, NON-CASH P&L driver worth Rs.18.91mn -- separated out here from operating (rental/commercial-property) income per the task's ASCO-specific guidance; with no prior-year comparative fair-value gain disclosed (blank/nil in 2025), and revenue growth of only 9.4%, this fair-value gain contributed materially to the swing from a Rs.54.66mn pre-tax loss to a Rs.39.86mn pre-tax profit (roughly half of the total ~Rs.94.5mn PBT swing). tax_expense=(8,550): filing shows 'Tax (expense) 8,550' un-bracketed = a tax REVERSAL/benefit this period (2025: (19,262), a genuine expense), so stored as negative per the pbt-tax=pat convention: PBT 39,862 - tax (8,550) = 48,412, ties exactly to reported 'Profit for the period'. eps_basic=0.03, only one EPS line given ('Earnings per share'), eps_diluted mirrors it -- based on 'Profit attributable to Equity holders of the parent' (Rs.6,561k) over ~211.4mn shares in issue, NOT the total Group profit of Rs.48,412k (most of which -- Rs.41,852k -- is attributable to Non-Controlling Interest, reflecting ASCO's partial ownership of Lee Hedges PLC/On'ally Holdings PLC etc). shares_in_issue=211,370,428 (Note 7, ordinary shares, unchanged QoQ). short_term_borrowings=4,761,593 = Current portion of Interest bearing borrowings (3,465,650) PLUS Bank overdraft (1,295,943); long_term_borrowings=307,491 (non-current Interest bearing borrowings). trade_receivables=525,539 ('Trade and other receivable', excludes the separate 'Amount due from related parties' 185,974 line). trade_payables=201,417 ('Trade and other payables', excludes 'Amount due to related parties' 1,588,961). inventory=1,686,908 ('Inventories'). cash_and_equivalents=3,403,348 ('Cash in hand and at bank'; excludes 'Short-term investments' 20,473, kept out per line-item discipline). CASH FLOW CAUTION: the filing's cash flow statement comparative column is headed '31-03-2026' (i.e. prior FULL YEAR / prior quarter-end date), NOT the prior-year same quarter (30-06-2025) -- unlike the P&L and balance sheet. Accordingly no cash flow YoY comparison is presented in interim_updates for this reason; only the current-period (30-06-2026) cash flow figures are stored. cash_from_operations=483,418 ('Net cash generated from/(used in) operating activities'); capex=0 (no 'Acquisition of property, plant & equipment' outflow shown for the current period -- line shows a dash); cash_from_investing=1,610,334 (dominated by 'Dispose of subsidiary' proceeds of 1,610,334, the LRD divestment discussed below -- eliminated at Group level from the P&L gain but the cash proceeds DO flow through Group cash flow since LRD's cash left the Group on disposal); cash_from_financing=235,050. CORPORATE ACTION (pages 2-3): during the quarter LRI PLC divested its direct 51% shareholding in Lanka Realty Developments (Pvt) Ltd to Lee Hedges PLC (an intra-Group restructuring); the ~Rs.709.98mn disposal gain is recognised ONLY at Company (standalone) level and is eliminated on consolidation, hence does not appear in the Group P&L above. SUBSEQUENT EVENT (non-adjusting, page 2): on 22 July 2026 LRI PLC divested its entire 50.886% direct shareholding in On'ally Holdings PLC (47,325,368 shares) to Lee Hedges PLC for ~Rs.2.26bn -- Group control of On'ally is retained indirectly via LRI's 51% interest in Lee Hedges PLC; not reflected in these 30 June 2026 figures. Identity check: total_liabilities (12,496,213) + total_equity (17,836,758) = 30,332,971, vs total_assets 30,332,972 (Rs.1k rounding), ties.

interim_updates.note_text: Lanka Realty Investments PLC (ASCO) reported Group Profit After Tax of Rs.48.41mn for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, a turnaround from a Group loss of Rs.73.93mn in the comparative quarter, on Group Revenue up 9.4% YoY to Rs.320.18mn (2025: Rs.292.58mn). Group gross profit jumped 77.5% to Rs.179.43mn (2025: Rs.101.09mn), with gross margin expanding sharply to 56.0% from 34.5%. Other operating income surged to Rs.39.69mn from Rs.3.86mn (+929.6%). Group operating profit rose 628.7% to Rs.79.66mn (2025: Rs.10.93mn). Net finance expenses fell 10.5% to Rs.58.71mn (2025: Rs.65.59mn), helped by finance income more than doubling to Rs.17.05mn (2025: Rs.6.99mn). A distinct, materially large fair-value gain on investment property/inventory of Rs.18.91mn (nil in the comparative quarter) contributed roughly half of the ~Rs.94.5mn swing in Group profit before tax, from a loss of Rs.54.66mn to a profit of Rs.39.86mn -- this is a non-cash P&L item, separate from the Group's underlying commercial-property (rental) operating income, and should not be read as a recurring operating improvement. Profit attributable to equity holders of the parent was only Rs.6.56mn (2025: loss of Rs.90.25mn) -- most of the Rs.48.41mn Group profit (Rs.41.85mn) accrued to Non-Controlling Interest, reflecting ASCO's partial ownership stakes in Lee Hedges PLC/On'ally Holdings PLC and other subsidiaries, so Group EPS of Rs.0.03 (2025: loss per share of Rs.0.43) understates the scale of the underlying Group profit improvement from a minority-shareholder perspective. At Company (standalone) level, profit after tax was Rs.750.90mn (2025: Rs.44.83mn, +1,574.7%) and EPS was Rs.3.55 (2025: Rs.0.21) -- this was overwhelmingly driven by a one-off Rs.709.98mn gain on disposal of Lanka Realty Developments (Private) Limited (LRD), sold to fellow-subsidiary Lee Hedges PLC as part of an intra-Group property restructuring; this gain is a Company-only item, entirely ELIMINATED on consolidation, so it does not appear in the Group figures above and should not be read as a Group-level profit driver. Balance sheet: Group cash in hand and at bank surged to Rs.3,403.35mn from Rs.165.04mn at 31 March 2026 (comparative balance-sheet date, not a YoY figure), largely reflecting proceeds of Rs.1,610.33mn from the LRD disposal flowing through Group investing cash flow even though the P&L gain itself is eliminated. Subsequent to the quarter-end, on 22 July 2026 (a non-adjusting event, not reflected in these figures), LRI PLC divested its entire 50.886% direct shareholding in On'ally Holdings PLC to Lee Hedges PLC for ~Rs.2.26bn, retaining indirect Group control via its 51% stake in Lee Hedges PLC.
interim_updates.gaps_note: No QoQ comparison possible: no quarter closer to 30 June 2026 has been collected for ASCO -- this is the first financial_statements entry for this symbol. No cash flow YoY comparison is included: the cash flow statement's comparative column is headed '31-03-2026' (prior fiscal year-end date), not the prior-year same quarter (30-06-2025) -- unlike the P&L and balance sheet, which do give a clean same-quarter comparative -- flagged in detail in the GROUP row's notes field. Occupancy/lease-up metrics for the commercial property platform (Lee Hedges PLC, On'ally Holdings PLC) and any per-property rental yield disclosures are NOT given in this filing -- a genuine gap, not a data-entry omission. The composition of the Rs.18.91mn fair-value gain (which investment properties drove it, and at what valuation basis) is not broken down in this filing beyond the single P&L line. No occupancy/ADR data applies (Real Estate, not Leisure/Hotels) though the Group does have a small Leisure segment (Note 4, page 9) -- segment revenue Rs.36.59mn, PBT loss of Rs.12.34mn -- for which no further operational detail (e.g. occupancy) is disclosed.
interim_updates.takeaway: ASCO's Group turnaround to a Rs.48.41mn profit (from a Rs.73.93mn loss) looks strong at first glance, but roughly half of the ~Rs.94.5mn improvement in profit before tax came from a one-off, non-cash Rs.18.91mn fair-value gain on investment property/inventory rather than the underlying commercial-property operating business, and 87% of the Group profit (Rs.41.85mn of Rs.48.41mn) accrued to Non-Controlling Interest rather than parent shareholders, making the headline Rs.0.03 Group EPS look modest despite the scale of the reported turnaround. Separately, the Company (standalone) Rs.750.90mn profit and Rs.3.55 EPS are almost entirely a one-off intra-Group gain on the LRD disposal that is fully eliminated at Group level -- investors should look through both of these one-off items to the underlying ~Rs.79.66mn Group operating profit (+628.7% YoY) as the more sustainable signal from this quarter.

operational_highlights: Group Revenue Rs.320.18mn, +9.4% YoY (2025: Rs.292.58mn); Group gross margin expanded to 56.0% from 34.5%; Group operating profit +628.7% YoY to Rs.79.66mn.

Group turned from a pre-tax loss of Rs.54.66mn to a pre-tax profit of Rs.39.86mn; a distinct fair-value gain on investment property/inventory of Rs.18.91mn (nil in 2025) contributed roughly half of the ~Rs.94.5mn swing -- a non-cash item, separate from operating (rental) income.
Profit attributable to equity holders of the parent was only Rs.6.56mn (2025: loss of Rs.90.25mn) of the Group's total Rs.48.41mn profit; Rs.41.85mn accrued to Non-Controlling Interest.

Company (standalone) PAT Rs.750.90mn (2025: Rs.44.83mn, +1,574.7%), driven overwhelmingly by a one-off Rs.709.98mn gain on disposal of Lanka Realty Developments (Pvt) Ltd to fellow-subsidiary Lee Hedges PLC -- eliminated entirely on consolidation, does not appear in Group figures.
Group cash in hand and at bank rose to Rs.3,403.35mn from Rs.165.04mn at 31 March 2026, aided by Rs.1,610.33mn of investing cash inflow from the LRD disposal.

Subsequent event (22 July 2026, non-adjusting): LRI PLC divested its entire 50.886% direct stake in On'ally Holdings PLC to Lee Hedges PLC for ~Rs.2.26bn, retaining indirect Group control via its 51% stake in Lee Hedges PLC.
key_drivers: Fair-value gain on investment property/inventory of Rs.18.91mn (Group, nil in the comparative quarter) contributed roughly half of the ~Rs.94.5mn swing in Group PBT from a Rs.54.66mn loss to a Rs.39.86mn profit -- a non-cash, non-operating item.

Non-Controlling Interest absorbed Rs.41.85mn of the Group's Rs.48.41mn total profit, leaving only Rs.6.56mn attributable to parent-company equity holders -- the underlying operating improvement is materially larger than the Rs.0.03 Group EPS suggests.

Company (standalone) profit of Rs.750.90mn was driven almost entirely by a one-off Rs.709.98mn intra-Group gain on disposal of Lanka Realty Developments (Pvt) Ltd -- eliminated on consolidation, not a Group-level driver.
